truth_source.dataset_title: Solitary Islands Marine Park 2022-23 landform, substrate and ecosystem mapping from MBES, towed-video and sediment surveys

frozen_characterization_rules.video_track_coverage: covered iff mapped towed-video track geometry intersects the frozen candidate disk; also report exact nearest distance
frozen_characterization_rules.sediment_coverage: covered iff georeferenced sediment sample point lies inside the frozen candidate disk; also report exact nearest distance
frozen_characterization_rules.image_annotation_use: only annotations tied to imagery whose georeferenced positions intersect a frozen candidate disk may be summarized for that candidate
frozen_characterization_rules.landform_or_substrate_use: descriptive characterization only after spatial intersection; never used to alter candidate or formal v2 result
